Jump envelope: g = 20 m/s²; vᵧ = 7.5 m/s → apex 1.41 m; flight 0.75 s; 6.00 m at 8 m/s. Use adjacent live hexes. A
missing 5.54 m hex span plus bean clearance exceeds ideal reach; descend to the next layer instead.
60 spots are drawn at true bean diameter 0.8 m. Collider sizes and movement sweeps are in metres. All controls,
timings, friction, grouping and respawn rules are proposed Level-panel data.

At 105 s start removing batches of 5 remaining cells every 6 s, each
with 8 s warning. Last-standing tie rules apply.
Elimination: drops between layers remain alive; below bottom layer
= OUT, no respawn. Mid-round quota or FINAL last standing. Target
90–150 s; 150 s regulation then tie overtime.
